post.description: Leave startAt out for a walk-in starting now (startAt = server time, FR-MAN-04). Opening hours and the Area do not gate it (FR-MAN-03); no back-dating (FR-MAN-05); missing pricing is MANUAL_BOOKING_PRICING_CONFIGURATION_MISSING and creates nothing (FR-MAN-10). Always has a businessDate (FR-MAN-09): the operating day when the whole interval fits one published session, otherwise the Africa/Cairo date of startAt. customerName and customerPhone are trimmed and a blank one is absent; customerPhone is normalised to E.164 like the venue phone (VALIDATION_FAILED otherwise). An ONBOARDING venue is FORBIDDEN (FR-MAN-02; PO decision 5 Oct 2026); a venue account disabled meanwhile is FORBIDDEN too (the token itself stops working: 401). A closure, emergency or maintenance in the interval is SLOT_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE, as is another booking on it; a selling block now is VENUE_SELLING_BLOCK_ACTIVE / RESOURCE_SELLING_BLOCK_ACTIVE (PO decision 10 Oct 2026, E7-48). A Resource of another venue is NOT_FOUND. No Owner Password. Implemented by E7-48.

post.description: Revalidated atomically (FR-BOK-14); marketplace ACTIVE is not required (FR-BOK-15). At or after venueResponseExpiresAt it is DEADLINE_PASSED (expiry wins at the boundary). When an emergency or owner review stops the confirmation, the booking is cancelled under that cause (FR-BOK-16) and the venue gets the matching 422 (VENUE_SELLING_BLOCK_ACTIVE, RESOURCE_SELLING_BLOCK_ACTIVE or RESOURCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE; PO decision 5 Oct 2026). A booking no longer PENDING is BOOKING_STATE_CHANGED. No Owner Password. Order (PO decision D7, 10 Oct 2026): not PENDING, then a paused response timer, then the deadline, then the revalidation. While an emergency pauses the response timer the Accept is refused and nothing changes: VENUE_SELLING_BLOCK_ACTIVE (venue-level pause) or RESOURCE_SELLING_BLOCK_ACTIVE (resource-level pause); nothing is stored, so a retry with the same key is evaluated afresh (D8). So the same 422 code can mean "still PENDING (paused)" or "cancelled (FR-BOK-16)": the dashboard must reload the booking after any 422 on Accept. A customer who is not eligible now (banned, deleted or restricted) is CUSTOMER_NOT_ELIGIBLE, the booking unchanged and the reason never told (D9). A venue account that is not ENABLED is FORBIDDEN. A booking of another venue is NOT_FOUND. A replay of an Accept that cancelled answers the same 422. Implemented by E7-47.
